column1: # Seed properties for the terminal-ballistics model. The caller's World callback
# normally returns a Material directly; this table is a convenience for games
# that want the shipped seeds (pon::materials::get("oak")). A game adds its own
#   behaviour       Brittle | Ductile | Fibrous | Membrane | Granular | Fluid
#   toughness_j_m2  energy per unit crack area
#   thickness_m     default slab thickness (<=0 or large => treat as bulk)
#   enters_medium   medium id a projectile enters on perforation (-1 = unchanged;
# Concrete / wood / steel refs: Terminal ballistic loading on thick concrete
# (Constr. Build. Mater. S0950061820309041); Bullet penetration into wooden
# targets (ResearchGate 319860218); Ballistic penetration of hardened steel
# plates (METU thesis 12613534). Oak strength is the Poncelet-validated value
